question: A 60 W bulb and a 40 W bulb are connected in series to a 100 V supply. Which bulb glows brighter?
explanation: In series the same current flows; power = I²R, and the 40 W bulb has higher resistance (R = V²/P), so it dissipates more power and glows brighter.

explanation_ne: श्रृंखलामा उही धारा बग्छ; शक्ति = I²R, र ४० W बल्बको प्रतिरोध बढी हुन्छ (R = V²/P), त्यसैले यसले बढी शक्ति खर्च गर्छ र बढी उज्यालो बल्छ।

question: The force between two charges is halved if the distance between them is:
explanation: Coulomb's law: F ∝ 1/r²; to halve F, r must increase by √2 (since 1/(√2)² = 1/2).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दुई आवेशबीचको बल आधा हुन्छ यदि तिनबीचको दूरी:
explanation_ne: कुलम्ब नियम: F ∝ 1/r²; F आधा गर्न r लाई √2 ले बढाउनुपर्छ (किनकि 1/(√2)² = 1/2)।

question: The force between two charges becomes one-fourth if the distance between them is:
explanation: Coulomb's law: F ∝ 1/r²; doubling r makes F one-fourth.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दुई आवेशबीचको बल एक चौथाइ हुन्छ यदि तिनबीचको दूरी:
explanation_ne: कुलम्ब नियम: F ∝ १/r²; r दोब्बर भए F एक चौथाइ हुन्छ।

question: A satellite orbits Earth at a height where g is one-fourth of its surface value. Its orbital radius is:
explanation: g ∝ 1/r²; g = g₀/4 means r = 2R (twice Earth's radius from the centre).

question_ne: एउटा उपग्रह पृथ्वीको त्यो उचाइमा परिक्रमा गर्छ जहाँ g सतहको मानको एक चौथाइ हुन्छ। यसको कक्षीय अर्धव्यास कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: g ∝ 1/r²; g = g₀/4 भए r = 2R हुन्छ (केन्द्रबाट पृथ्वीको अर्धव्यासको दोब्बर)।

question_ne: विलयनको pH ३ बाट ५ मा बढे यसको [H⁺] कति गुणाले घट्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रत्येक pH एकाइ १० गुणा परिवर्तन हो; २ एकाइ = १०² = [H⁺] मा १०० गुणा कमी।

question: The volume occupied by 1 mole of any gas at STP is about:
explanation: At STP (0°C, 1 atm), 1 mole of an ideal gas occupies 22.4 L.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: STP मा कुनै पनि ग्यासको १ मोलले ओगट्ने आयतन लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: STP (०°से, १ atm) मा आदर्श ग्यासको १ मोलले २२.४ लिटर ओगट्छ।

question: The volume occupied by 2 moles of oxygen at STP is about:
explanation: 1 mol occupies 22.4 L at STP, so 2 mol occupy 44.8 L.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: STP मा २ मोल अक्सिजनले ओगट्ने आयतन लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: STP मा १ मोलले २२.४ लिटर ओगट्छ, त्यसैले २ मोलले ४४.८ लिटर ओगट्छ।

question: According to Avogadro's law, equal volumes of gases at the same temperature and pressure contain:
explanation: Avogadro's law: equal volumes of gases at the same T and P contain equal numbers of molecules.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एभोगाड्रो नियमअनुसार उही तापक्रम र दबाबमा ग्यासका बराबर आयतनमा के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: एभोगाड्रो नियम: उही तापक्रम र दबाबमा ग्यासका बराबर आयतनमा बराबर संख्यामा अणु हुन्छन्।

question: Boyle's law states that at constant temperature, the pressure of a gas is:
options: Proportional to the square of volume
explanation: Boyle's law: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂ at constant temperature.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बोयल नियमअनुसार स्थिर तापक्रममा ग्यासको दबाब यसको आयतनसँग कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बोयल नियम: स्थिर तापक्रममा P₁V₁ = P₂V₂।

question: A gas occupies 2 L at 1 atm. If the pressure is doubled at constant temperature, the new volume is:
explanation: Boyle's law: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂ → 1 × 2 = 2 × V₂, so V₂ = 1 L.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्यासले १ atm मा २ लिटर ओगट्छ। स्थिर तापक्रममा दबाब दोब्बर भए नयाँ आयतन कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बोयल नियम: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂ → १ × २ = २ × V₂, त्यसैले V₂ = १ लिटर।

question: Charles's law states that at constant pressure, the volume of a gas is:
options: Directly proportional to its absolute temperature
explanation: Charles's law: V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂ at constant pressure (T in kelvin).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चार्ल्स नियमअनुसार स्थिर दबाबमा ग्यासको आयतन यसको निरपेक्ष तापक्रमसँग कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: चार्ल्स नियम: स्थिर दबाबमा V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂ (T केल्भिनमा)।

question: The ideal gas equation is:
explanation: The ideal gas equation is PV = nRT, where R = 8.314 J/mol·K.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आदर्श ग्यास समीकरण कुन हो?
explanation_ne: आदर्श ग्यास समीकरण PV = nRT हो, जहाँ R = ८.३१४ J/mol·K।

question: The value of the universal gas constant R is about:
explanation: R = 8.314 J/mol·K (0.0821 L·atm/mol·K); 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J/K is Boltzmann's constant k.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विश्वव्यापी ग्यास स्थिरांक R को मान लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: R = ८.३१४ J/mol·K (०.०८२१ L·atm/mol·K); १.३८ × १०⁻²³ J/K बोल्ट्जमान स्थिरांक k हो।

question: In the reaction 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, how many moles of water are formed from 4 moles of hydrogen?
explanation: The ratio H₂:H₂O is 2:2 = 1:1, so 4 mol H₂ gives 4 mol H₂O.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O अभिक्रियामा ४ मोल हाइड्रोजनबाट कति मोल पानी बन्छ?
explanation_ne: H₂:H₂O अनुपात २:२ = १:१ हो, त्यसैले ४ मोल H₂ बाट ४ मोल H₂O बन्छ।

question: In the reaction N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃, how many moles of ammonia are formed from 3 moles of nitrogen?
explanation: The ratio N₂:NH₃ is 1:2, so 3 mol N₂ gives 6 mol NH₃.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ अभिक्रियामा ३ मोल नाइट्रोजनबाट कति मोल अमोनिया बन्छ?
explanation_ne: N₂:NH₃ अनुपात १:२ हो, त्यसैले ३ मोल N₂ बाट ६ मोल NH₃ बन्छ।

question: The oxidation number of sulphur in H₂SO₄ is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: H₂SO₄ मा सल्फरको अक्सीकरण संख्या कति हुन्छ?

question: The oxidation number of manganese in KMnO₄ is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: KMnO₄ मा म्यांगनीजको अक्सीकरण संख्या कति हुन्छ?

question: The oxidation number of chromium in K₂Cr₂O₇ is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: K₂Cr₂O₇ मा क्रोमियमको अक्सीकरण संख्या कति हुन्छ?

question: The oxidation number of carbon in CO₂ is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: CO₂ मा कार्बनको अक्सीकरण संख्या कति हुन्छ?

question: In the reaction Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu, zinc is:
options: Oxidised (its oxidation number rises from 0 to +2)
explanation: Zn goes from 0 to +2 (loses electrons, oxidised); Cu²⁺ goes from +2 to 0 (reduced).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu अभिक्रियामा जिंक के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: Zn ० बाट +२ मा जान्छ (इलेक्ट्रोन गुमाउँछ, अक्सीकृत); Cu²⁺ +२ बाट ० मा जान्छ (अपचयित)।

question: Electrolysis of water produces hydrogen and oxygen in the volume ratio:
explanation: Electrolysis of water gives H₂ and O₂ in the volume ratio 2:1 (2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पानीको विद्युत्-अपघटनले हाइड्रोजन र अक्सिजन कुन आयतन अनुपातमा बनाउँछ?
explanation_ne: पानीको विद्युत्-अपघटनले H₂ र O₂ लाई २:१ आयतन अनुपातमा दिन्छ (2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂)।

question: In electrolysis, the cathode is the electrode where:
explanation: Cathode: reduction (gain of electrons); anode: oxidation (loss of electrons).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विद्युत्-अपघटनमा क्याथोड भनेको कुन इलेक्ट्रोड हो जहाँ:
explanation_ne: क्याथोड: अपचयन (इलेक्ट्रोन प्राप्ति); एनोड: अक्सीकरण (इलेक्ट्रोन हानि)।

question: In electrolysis, the anode is the electrode where:
explanation: Anode: oxidation (loss of electrons); cathode: reduction (gain of electrons).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विद्युत्-अपघटनमा एनोड भनेको कुन इलेक्ट्रोड हो जहाँ:
explanation_ne: एनोड: अक्सीकरण (इलेक्ट्रोन हानि); क्याथोड: अपचयन (इलेक्ट्रोन प्राप्ति)।

question: The Faraday constant is approximately:
explanation: One faraday (96,485 C) is the charge of one mole of electrons.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फ्याराडे स्थिरांक लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: एक फ्याराडे (९६,४८५ C) भनेको एक मोल इलेक्ट्रोनको आवेश हो।

question: The chemical formula of bleaching powder is:
explanation: Bleaching powder is calcium oxychloride, Ca(OCl)Cl (often written CaOCl₂).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ब्लिचिङ पाउडरको रासायनिक सूत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: ब्लिचिङ पाउडर क्याल्सियम अक्सिक्लोराइड, Ca(OCl)Cl (प्रायः CaOCl₂ लेखिन्छ) हो।

question: The chemical formula of quicklime is:
explanation: Quicklime is calcium oxide, CaO; slaked lime is Ca(OH)₂ and limestone is CaCO₃.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्विकलाइमको रासायनिक सूत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: क्विकलाइम क्याल्सियम अक्साइड, CaO हो; स्लेक्ड लाइम Ca(OH)₂ र चुनढुंगा CaCO₃ हो।

question: The chemical formula of slaked lime is:
explanation: Slaked lime is calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)₂, made by adding water to quicklime (CaO).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्लेक्ड लाइमको रासायनिक सूत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: स्लेक्ड लाइम क्याल्सियम हाइड्रोक्साइड, Ca(OH)₂ हो, क्विकलाइम (CaO) मा पानी थपेर बनाइन्छ।

question: The rate of a chemical reaction generally doubles for every rise in temperature of about:
explanation: As a rule of thumb, reaction rates roughly double for each 10°C rise in temperature.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रासायनिक अभिक्रियाको दर सामान्यतया तापक्रम कति बढ्दा दोब्बर हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: सामान्य नियमअनुसार तापक्रम प्रत्येक १०°से बढ्दा अभिक्रिया दर लगभग दोब्बर हुन्छ।

question: A catalyst increases the rate of a reaction by:
explanation: A catalyst provides an alternative pathway with lower activation energy; it does not change the equilibrium position.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: उत्प्रेरकले अभिक्रियाको दर कसरी बढाउँछ?
explanation_ne: उत्प्रेरकले कम सक्रियण ऊर्जासहित वैकल्पिक बाटो दिन्छ; यसले सन्तुलन स्थिति बदल्दैन।

question: In a monohybrid cross of heterozygous tall (Tt) pea plants, the phenotypic ratio in the F2 generation is:
explanation: Tt × Tt gives TT, Tt, Tt, tt — 3 tall (TT, Tt, Tt) and 1 dwarf (tt).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विषमयुग्मजी अग्लो (Tt) केराउ बिरुवाको एकसंकर संकरणमा F2 पुस्तामा फेनोटाइप अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: Tt × Tt बाट TT, Tt, Tt, tt हुन्छ — ३ अग्लो (TT, Tt, Tt) र १ होचो (tt)।

question: In a monohybrid cross of heterozygous tall (Tt) pea plants, the genotypic ratio in the F2 generation is:
explanation: Tt × Tt gives 1 TT, 2 Tt and 1 tt — genotypic ratio 1:2:1.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विषमयुग्मजी अग्लो (Tt) केराउ बिरुवाको एकसंकर संकरणमा F2 पुस्तामा जीनोटाइप अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: Tt × Tt बाट १ TT, २ Tt र १ tt हुन्छ — जीनोटाइप अनुपात १:२:१।

question: In a dihybrid cross (RrYy × RrYy), the phenotypic ratio in the F2 generation is:
explanation: The dihybrid cross gives 9 round-yellow : 3 round-green : 3 wrinkled-yellow : 1 wrinkled-green.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: द्विसंकर संकरण (RrYy × RrYy) मा F2 पुस्तामा फेनोटाइप अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: द्विसंकर संकरणले ९ गोलो-पहेंलो : ३ गोलो-हरियो : ३ चाउरिएको-पहेंलो : १ चाउरिएको-हरियो दिन्छ।

question: A test cross is a cross between an individual of unknown genotype and:
options: An individual of the same genotype
explanation: A test cross (unknown × homozygous recessive) reveals whether the unknown is homozygous or heterozygous dominant.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: परीक्षण संकरण भनेको अज्ञात जीनोटाइप भएको व्यक्तिसँग कसको संकरण हो?
explanation_ne: परीक्षण संकरण (अज्ञात × समयुग्मजी अप्रभावी) ले अज्ञात समयुग्मजी वा विषमयुग्मजी प्रभावी हो भनी देखाउँछ।

question: In humans, the sex of a child is determined by:
options: The father (whether the sperm carries X or Y)
explanation: The father contributes either an X or a Y chromosome; XX is female and XY is male.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानवमा बच्चाको लिंग कसले निर्धारण गर्छ?
options_ne: बुबा (शुक्रकीटले X वा Y बोक्छ भन्ने आधारमा)
explanation_ne: बुबाले X वा Y क्रोमोजोम दिन्छ; XX महिला र XY पुरुष हुन्छ।

question: Colour blindness in humans is most commonly inherited as a:
explanation: Red-green colour blindness is usually X-linked recessive, so it is far more common in males.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानवमा वर्णान्धता सामान्यतया कसरी वंशानुगत हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: रातो-हरियो वर्णान्धता सामान्यतया X-सम्बद्ध अप्रभावी हुन्छ, त्यसैले पुरुषमा धेरै सामान्य छ।

question: Haemophilia is inherited as a:
explanation: Haemophilia is X-linked recessive, so males are affected far more often than females.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हेमोफिलिया कसरी वंशानुगत हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: हेमोफिलिया X-सम्बद्ध अप्रभावी हुन्छ, त्यसैले पुरुष महिला भन्दा धेरै प्रभावित हुन्छन्।

question: Turner syndrome is caused by:
options: Monosomy of the X chromosome (45, XO)
explanation: Turner syndrome is 45, XO — a female with only one X chromosome.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: टर्नर सिन्ड्रोम के कारण हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: टर्नर सिन्ड्रोम ४५, XO हो — एउटा मात्र X क्रोमोजोम भएको महिला।

question: Klinefelter syndrome is caused by:
explanation: Klinefelter syndrome is 47, XXY — a male with an extra X chromosome.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्लाइनफेल्टर सिन्ड्रोम के कारण हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्लाइनफेल्टर सिन्ड्रोम ४७, XXY हो — थप X क्रोमोजोम भएको पुरुष।

question: How many autosomes are there in a normal human cell?
explanation: Of the 46 chromosomes, 44 are autosomes (22 pairs) and 2 are sex chromosomes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य मानव कोषमा कति अटोसोम हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: ४६ क्रोमोजोममध्ये ४४ अटोसोम (२२ जोडी) र २ लिंग क्रोमोजोम हुन्छन्।

question: The number of chromosomes in a human gamete (sperm or egg) is:
explanation: Gametes are haploid with 23 chromosomes; fertilisation restores 46.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानव युग्मक (शुक्रकीट वा अण्डा) मा क्रोमोजोम संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: युग्मक अगुणित हुन्छन्, २३ क्रोमोजोमसहित; निषेचनले ४६ पुनर्स्थापित गर्छ।

question: DNA replication is described as semi-conservative because:
options: Each new DNA molecule has one old strand and one new strand
explanation: Meselson and Stahl showed each daughter DNA keeps one parental strand and one newly made strand.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DNA प्रतिकृतिलाई अर्ध-संरक्षणात्मक किन भनिन्छ?
options_ne: प्रत्येक नयाँ DNA अणुमा एउटा पुरानो र एउटा नयाँ सूत्र हुन्छ
explanation_ne: मेसेल्सन र स्टालले प्रत्येक छोरी DNA ले एउटा पैतृक सूत्र र एउटा नयाँ बनेको सूत्र राख्छ भनी देखाए।

question: The enzyme that unzips DNA during replication is:
explanation: Helicase unwinds the double helix; DNA polymerase builds the new strand; ligase joins fragments.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रतिकृतिका बेला DNA खोल्ने इन्जाइम कुन हो?
explanation_ne: हेलिकेजले दोहोरो हेलिक्स खोल्छ; DNA पोलिमरेजले नयाँ सूत्र बनाउँछ; लिगेजले टुक्रा जोड्छ।

question: The enzyme that joins Okazaki fragments during DNA replication is:
explanation: DNA ligase seals the nicks between Okazaki fragments on the lagging strand.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DNA प्रतिकृतिका बेला ओकाजाकी टुक्रा जोड्ने इन्जाइम कुन हो?
explanation_ne: DNA लिगेजले ल्यागिङ सूत्रमा ओकाजाकी टुक्राबीचको खाली ठाउँ बन्द गर्छ।

question: Transcription is the process of making:
explanation: Transcription copies a DNA gene into mRNA; translation then builds protein from mRNA.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ट्रान्सक्रिप्सन भनेको के बनाउने प्रक्रिया हो?
explanation_ne: ट्रान्सक्रिप्सनले DNA जीनलाई mRNA मा प्रतिलिपि गर्छ; अनुवादले त्यसपछि mRNA बाट प्रोटिन बनाउँछ।

question: Translation in protein synthesis occurs in the:
explanation: Translation (mRNA → protein) occurs at ribosomes; transcription (DNA → mRNA) occurs in the nucleus.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रोटिन संश्लेषणमा अनुवाद कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: अनुवाद (mRNA → प्रोटिन) राइबोजोममा हुन्छ; ट्रान्सक्रिप्सन (DNA → mRNA) केन्द्रकमा हुन्छ।

question: How many codons code for amino acids (excluding stop codons)?
explanation: Of the 64 codons, 61 code for amino acids and 3 are stop codons.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन अंगलाई कोषको आत्महत्यात्मक झोला भनिन्छ?

question: The fluid mosaic model describes the structure of the:

question_ne: फ्लुइड मोजाइक मोडेलले कुनको संरचना वर्णन गर्छ?

question: Photosynthesis takes place in the:
explanation: Photosynthesis occurs in chloroplasts — light reactions in the thylakoids, Calvin cycle in the stroma.

question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषण कहाँ हुन्छ?

question: The Calvin cycle of photosynthesis takes place in the:
explanation: The light reactions occur in the thylakoids; the Calvin cycle (carbon fixation) occurs in the stroma.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणको क्याल्भिन चक्र कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रकाश अभिक्रिया थाइलाकोइडमा हुन्छ; क्याल्भिन चक्र (कार्बन स्थिरीकरण) स्ट्रोमामा हुन्छ।

question: The light reactions of photosynthesis take place in the:
explanation: Light reactions occur in the thylakoid membranes (grana); the Calvin cycle occurs in the stroma.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणको प्रकाश अभिक्रिया कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रकाश अभिक्रिया थाइलाकोइड झिल्ली (ग्राना) मा हुन्छ; क्याल्भिन चक्र स्ट्रोमामा हुन्छ।

question: The net gain of ATP in glycolysis (per glucose molecule) is:
explanation: Glycolysis produces 4 ATP but uses 2, so the net gain is 2 ATP (plus 2 NADH).

question_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिसमा ATP को शुद्ध लाभ (प्रति ग्लुकोज अणु) कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिसले ४ ATP बनाउँछ तर २ प्रयोग गर्छ, त्यसैले शुद्ध लाभ २ ATP (साथै २ NADH) हो।

question: The Krebs cycle (citric acid cycle) takes place in the:
explanation: Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm; the Krebs cycle occurs in the mitochondrial matrix.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्रेब्स चक्र (साइट्रिक एसिड चक्र) कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस कोषद्रव्यमा हुन्छ; क्रेब्स चक्र माइटोकन्ड्रियल म्याट्रिक्समा हुन्छ।

question: Glycolysis takes place in the:
explanation: Glycolysis (splitting of glucose) occurs in the cytoplasm of the cell.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस (ग्लुकोज विभाजन) कोषको कोषद्रव्यमा हुन्छ।

question: The exchange of gases in the lungs takes place in the:
explanation: Gas exchange occurs across the thin walls of the alveoli (air sacs) into the surrounding capillaries.

question_ne: फोक्सोमा ग्यास आदानप्रदान कहाँ हुन्छ?

question: The functional unit of the nervous system is the:

question_ne: स्नायु प्रणालीको कार्यात्मक एकाइ कुन हो?

question: Insulin is secreted by the:

question: Glucagon is secreted by the:

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्लुकागन कसले स्राव गर्छ?
explanation_ne: अग्न्याशय द्वीपका अल्फा कोषले ग्लुकागन स्राव गर्छन्, जसले रगतमा ग्लुकोज बढाउँछ; बिटा कोषले इन्सुलिन स्राव गर्छन्।

question: Which article of the Constitution of Nepal deals with the structure of the State?

explanation_ne: धारा ५७ ले संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहबीच राज्यशक्तिको बाँडफाँट व्यवस्था गर्छ।

explanation_ne: धारा ५९ ले अवशिष्ट अधिकार (अनुसूचीमा नपरेका) संघमा रहन्छ भनी व्यवस्था गर्छ।

explanation_ne: धारा ७४ ले नेपालको कार्यकारिणी अधिकार मन्त्रिपरिषद्मा निहित गर्छ।

explanation_ne: धारा ७६ ले राष्ट्रपतिबाट प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्ति व्यवस्था गर्छ।

explanation_ne: धारा २४१ ले सरकारी कार्यालयको लेखा परीक्षण गर्न महालेखा परीक्षकको कार्यालय स्थापना गर्छ।

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको संविधानको कुन धारामा राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोगको व्यवस्था छ?
explanation_ne: धारा २५१ ले सरकारका तहबीच राजस्व बाँडफाँट सिफारिस गर्न राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोग स्थापना गर्छ।

question: Which article of the Constitution of Nepal provides that Nepal is a secular state?
explanation: Article 4 declares Nepal an independent, indivisible, sovereign, secular, inclusive, democratic, socialism-oriented federal democratic republican state.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको संविधानको कुन धारामा नेपाल धर्मनिरपेक्ष राज्य हो भनी व्यवस्था छ?
explanation_ne: धारा ४ ले नेपाललाई स्वतन्त्र, अविभाज्य, सार्वभौम, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, समावेशी, लोकतान्त्रिक, समाजवादोन्मुख संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रात्मक राज्य घोषणा गर्छ।

question: Which article of the Constitution of Nepal defines the national flag, national anthem and coat of arms?
explanation: Article 8 provides for the national flag, national anthem and coat of arms of Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको संविधानको कुन धारामा राष्ट्रिय झण्डा, राष्ट्रिय गान र निशान छाप परिभाषित छ?
explanation_ne: धारा ८ ले नेपालको राष्ट्रिय झण्डा, राष्ट्रिय गान र निशान छाप व्यवस्था गर्छ।

question: The functions of Nepal Rastra Bank include all of the following EXCEPT:
options: Acting as banker to the government
Accepting deposits from the general public
explanation: As a central bank, Nepal Rastra Bank issues currency, acts as banker to the government and formulates monetary policy — but it does not accept deposits from the general public.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकका कार्यमा तलकामध्ये कुन पर्दैन?
explanation_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकका रूपमा नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले मुद्रा जारी गर्छ, सरकारको बैंकका रूपमा काम गर्छ र मौद्रिक नीति तर्जुमा गर्छ — तर सर्वसाधारणबाट निक्षेप स्वीकार गर्दैन।

question: The currency notes of Nepal are issued by:
explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank has the sole right to issue currency notes in Nepal (coins are minted by the government).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालका मुद्रा नोट कसले जारी गर्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपालमा मुद्रा नोट जारी गर्ने एकल अधिकार नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकलाई छ (सिक्का सरकारले टक्सार गर्छ)।

question: Coins in Nepal are minted by:
options: The Government of Nepal (Ministry of Finance)
explanation: Coins are minted by the Government of Nepal, while banknotes are issued by Nepal Rastra Bank.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा सिक्का कसले टक्सार गर्छ?
explanation_ne: सिक्का नेपाल सरकारले टक्सार गर्छ, जबकि बैंकनोट नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले जारी गर्छ।

question: If the central bank raises the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR), the money supply in the economy will:
explanation: A higher CRR means banks must hold more reserves with the central bank, so they can lend less and the money supply falls.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकले नगद रिजर्भ अनुपात (CRR) बढाए अर्थतन्त्रमा मुद्रा आपूर्ति के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: उच्च CRR भए बैंकले केन्द्रीय बैंकमा बढी रिजर्भ राख्नुपर्छ, त्यसैले कम ऋण दिन सक्छन् र मुद्रा आपूर्ति घट्छ।

question: If the central bank lowers the bank rate, commercial banks' lending will generally:
explanation: A lower bank rate makes borrowing cheaper for banks, so they lend more and at lower rates.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकले बैंक दर घटाए वाणिज्य बैंकको ऋण सामान्यतया के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: कम बैंक दरले बैंकका लागि सापटी सस्तो बनाउँछ, त्यसैले तिनीहरू बढी र कम दरमा ऋण दिन्छन्।

question: Open market operations refer to the central bank's:
options: Buying and selling of government securities to control money supply
explanation: In open market operations the central bank buys securities to inject money or sells them to withdraw money from the system.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खुला बजार कारोबार भनेको केन्द्रीय बैंकको के हो?
options_ne: नयाँ मुद्रा नोट मात्र जारी गर्नु
मुद्रा आपूर्ति नियन्त्रण गर्न सरकारी धितोपत्र किनबेच गर्नु
explanation_ne: खुला बजार कारोबारमा केन्द्रीय बैंकले पैसा थप्न धितोपत्र किन्छ वा प्रणालीबाट पैसा झिक्न बेच्छ।

question: A bank's capital adequacy ratio (CAR) measures:
options: The bank's capital relative to its risk-weighted assets
explanation: CAR = capital / risk-weighted assets; it shows whether a bank has enough capital to absorb losses.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकको पुँजी पर्याप्तता अनुपात (CAR) ले के नाप्छ?
explanation_ne: CAR = पुँजी / जोखिम-भारित सम्पत्ति; यसले बैंकसँग हानि सहन पर्याप्त पुँजी छ कि छैन देखाउँछ।

question: Under the Basel framework, the minimum capital adequacy ratio for banks is generally:
explanation: The Basel framework sets a minimum CAR of 8% of risk-weighted assets; Nepal Rastra Bank requires higher levels for Nepali banks.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बासेल ढाँचाअनुसार बैंकका लागि न्यूनतम पुँजी पर्याप्तता अनुपात सामान्यतया कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बासेल ढाँचाले जोखिम-भारित सम्पत्तिको ८% न्यूनतम CAR निर्धारण गर्छ; नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले नेपाली बैंकका लागि उच्च स्तर माग गर्छ।

question: The financial institutions in Nepal are classified by Nepal Rastra Bank into:
explanation: NRB classifies financial institutions into Class A (commercial banks), Class B (development banks), Class C (finance companies) and Class D (microfinance institutions).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले नेपालका वित्तीय संस्थालाई कति वर्गमा वर्गीकरण गर्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले वित्तीय संस्थालाई क वर्ग (वाणिज्य बैंक), ख वर्ग (विकास बैंक), ग वर्ग (वित्त कम्पनी) र घ वर्ग (लघुवित्त संस्था) मा वर्गीकरण गर्छ।

question: Class 'A' financial institutions in Nepal are:
explanation: Class A = commercial banks; Class B = development banks; Class C = finance companies; Class D = microfinance institutions.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा 'क' वर्गका वित्तीय संस्था कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: क वर्ग = वाणिज्य बैंक; ख वर्ग = विकास बैंक; ग वर्ग = वित्त कम्पनी; घ वर्ग = लघुवित्त संस्था।

question: Class 'D' financial institutions in Nepal are:
explanation: Class D = microfinance institutions; Class A = commercial banks; Class B = development banks; Class C = finance companies.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा 'घ' वर्गका वित्तीय संस्था कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: घ वर्ग = लघुवित्त संस्था; क वर्ग = वाणिज्य बैंक; ख वर्ग = विकास बैंक; ग वर्ग = वित्त कम्पनी।

question: The Insurance Board of Nepal regulates:
explanation: The Insurance Board (now Nepal Insurance Authority) regulates insurers; NRB regulates banks and SEBON regulates the securities market.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको बीमा बोर्डले के नियमन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: बीमा बोर्ड (अहिले नेपाल बीमा प्राधिकरण) ले बीमक नियमन गर्छ; नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले बैंक र SEBON ले धितोपत्र बजार नियमन गर्छ।

question: A letter of credit (LC) is mainly used in:
explanation: A letter of credit is a bank's guarantee of payment to an exporter in international trade.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रतीतपत्र (LC) मुख्यतः कुनमा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रतीतपत्र भनेको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय व्यापारमा निर्यातकर्तालाई भुक्तानीको बैंक ग्यारेन्टी हो।

question: The SWIFT system is used for:
options: International interbank messaging and fund transfers
explanation: SWIFT is the global messaging network banks use to send secure payment instructions across borders.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: SWIFT प्रणाली कुनका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
options_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अन्तरबैंक सन्देश र रकम स्थानान्तरण
explanation_ne: SWIFT भनेको बैंकले सीमापार सुरक्षित भुक्तानी निर्देशन पठाउन प्रयोग गर्ने विश्वव्यापी सन्देश सञ्जाल हो।

question: The acronym 'NCHL' in Nepal stands for:
explanation: Nepal Clearing House Limited (NCHL) operates Nepal's electronic cheque clearing and payment systems.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा 'NCHL' को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: नेपाल क्लियरिङ हाउस लिमिटेड (NCHL) ले नेपालको इलेक्ट्रोनिक चेक क्लियरिङ र भुक्तानी प्रणाली सञ्चालन गर्छ।

question: The 'connectIPS' system in Nepal is a:
options: Bank-account-based online payment system operated by NCHL
explanation: connectIPS links bank accounts for online payments and fund transfers in Nepal, operated by Nepal Clearing House Ltd.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा 'कनेक्ट IPS' प्रणाली के हो?
options_ne: NCHL द्वारा सञ्चालित बैंक-खातामा आधारित अनलाइन भुक्तानी प्रणाली
explanation_ne: कनेक्ट IPS ले नेपालमा अनलाइन भुक्तानी र रकम स्थानान्तरणका लागि बैंक खाता जोड्छ, नेपाल क्लियरिङ हाउस लि. द्वारा सञ्चालित।

question: eSewa is Nepal's first:
explanation: eSewa, launched in 2009, was Nepal's first digital wallet and online payment service.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: eSewa नेपालको पहिलो के हो?
explanation_ne: सन् २००९ मा सुरु भएको eSewa नेपालको पहिलो डिजिटल वालेट र अनलाइन भुक्तानी सेवा थियो।

question: The first digital wallet in Nepal was:
explanation: eSewa, launched in 2009, was Nepal's first digital wallet; Khalti (2017) and IME Pay came later.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको पहिलो डिजिटल वालेट कुन थियो?
explanation_ne: सन् २००९ मा सुरु भएको eSewa नेपालको पहिलो डिजिटल वालेट थियो; खल्ती (२०१७) र IME Pay पछि आए।

question: FonePay in Nepal is mainly a:
explanation: FonePay provides interoperable QR payments and interbank fund transfers in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा FonePay मुख्यतः के हो?
options_ne: QR मा आधारित अन्तर-आबद्ध भुक्तानी सञ्जाल
explanation_ne: FonePay ले नेपालमा अन्तर-आबद्ध QR भुक्तानी र अन्तरबैंक रकम स्थानान्तरण प्रदान गर्छ।

question: A bank guarantee is:
options: A bank's promise to pay a third party if its customer defaults
explanation: A bank guarantee assures a beneficiary that the bank will pay if the customer fails to meet an obligation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंक ग्यारेन्टी भनेको के हो?
options_ne: ग्राहकले दायित्व पूरा नगरे तेस्रो पक्षलाई तिर्ने बैंकको वाचा
explanation_ne: बैंक ग्यारेन्टीले ग्राहकले दायित्व पूरा नगरे बैंकले तिर्छ भनी लाभग्राहीलाई आश्वासन दिन्छ।

question: The difference between a bank's interest income and interest expense is called its:
explanation: Net interest income = interest earned on loans minus interest paid on deposits; it is a bank's core earnings measure.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकको ब्याज आम्दानी र ब्याज खर्चबीचको भिन्नतालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: शुद्ध ब्याज आम्दानी = ऋणमा कमाएको ब्याज घटाई निक्षेपमा तिरेको ब्याज; यो बैंकको मुख्य आम्दानी माप हो।

question: A loan against gold is secured by:
options: Gold ornaments pledged with the bank
explanation: A gold loan is secured by pledging gold ornaments or coins with the lender.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुन धितो ऋण के बाट सुरक्षित हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: सुन ऋण ऋणदातासँग सुनका गहना वा सिक्का धितो राखेर सुरक्षित हुन्छ।

question: The term 'moratorium' in lending means:
options: A temporary pause in loan repayments
explanation: A moratorium is a period during which a borrower is not required to make repayments (interest may still accrue).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऋणमा 'मोराटोरियम' शब्दको अर्थ के हो?
explanation_ne: मोराटोरियम भनेको ऋणीले भुक्तानी गर्न नपर्ने अवधि हो (ब्याज भने बढिरहन सक्छ)।

question: A 'bad debt' for a bank is a loan that is:
explanation: A bad debt is a loan the bank considers unlikely to be recovered and may write off.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकका लागि 'खराब ऋण' भनेको कस्तो ऋण हो?
explanation_ne: खराब ऋण भनेको बैंकले उठ्ने सम्भावना नभएको ठानेको र मिनाहा गर्न सक्ने ऋण हो।

question: The 'base rate' system in Nepal was introduced to make lending rates more:
options: Transparent and linked to banks' cost of funds
explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank introduced the base rate so that banks' lending rates are transparently linked to their cost of funds.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा 'आधार दर' प्रणाली ऋण दरलाई अझ के बनाउन सुरु गरियो?
options_ne: पारदर्शी र बैंकको कोष लागतसँग जोडिएको
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले आधार दर सुरु गर्यो ताकि बैंकको ऋण दर पारदर्शी रूपमा तिनको कोष लागतसँग जोडियोस्।

question: Nepal Rastra Bank's monetary policy is announced:
explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank announces its monetary policy annually, at the start of each fiscal year.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको मौद्रिक नीति कहिले घोषणा गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले प्रत्येक आर्थिक वर्षको सुरुमा वार्षिक रूपमा मौद्रिक नीति घोषणा गर्छ।

question: The Foreign Exchange Regulation Act in Nepal primarily governs:
explanation: The Foreign Exchange (Regulation) Act governs the buying, selling and holding of foreign currency in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा विदेशी विनिमय नियमन ऐनले मुख्यतः के नियमन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: विदेशी विनिमय (नियमन) ऐनले नेपालमा विदेशी मुद्रा किनबेच र धारण नियमन गर्छ।

question: The maximum amount of Indian currency (INR) a Nepali citizen can carry to India is limited by:
options: The bank where they hold an account
Nepal Rastra Bank / Government of Nepal rules (INR 25,000 in denominations up to 100)
explanation: Nepali citizens may carry Indian currency to India only in denominations of INR 100 or below, up to INR 25,000, under NRB/Government rules (Indian notes of 500/1000 are not allowed).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाली नागरिकले भारत लैजान सक्ने भारतीय मुद्रा (INR) को अधिकतम रकम के ले सीमित गर्छ?
options_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक / नेपाल सरकारको नियम (१०० सम्मको दरमा INR २५,००० सम्म)
explanation_ne: नेपाली नागरिकले भारतमा १०० वा कम दरका भारतीय मुद्रा मात्र, INR २५,००० सम्म लैजान सक्छन्, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक/सरकारको नियमअनुसार (५००/१००० का भारतीय नोट अनुमति छैन)।

question: Nepal's foreign exchange reserves are managed by:
explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank manages the country's foreign exchange reserves.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको विदेशी विनिमय सञ्चिति कसले व्यवस्थापन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले देशको विदेशी विनिमय सञ्चिति व्यवस्थापन गर्छ।

question: What is the next number in the series 1, 2, 6, 24, ...?
explanation: Factorials: 1!, 2!, 3!, 4!, so next is 5! = 120.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

question: What is the next number in the series 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ...?
explanation: Prime numbers in order; next prime after 11 is 13.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
explanation_ne: क्रममा अभाज्य संख्या; ११ पछिको अर्को अभाज्य १३ हो।

question: What is the next number in the series 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, ...?
explanation: Triangular numbers; differences are 2, 3, 4, 5, so next difference is 6; 15 + 6 = 21.

question_ne: अन्नपूर्ण I आरोहण गरिएको पहिलो ८,००० मिटर शिखर थियो। यो कुन वर्षमा आरोहण गरियो?
explanation_ne: अन्नपूर्ण I सन् १९५० मा फ्रान्सका मोरिस हेर्जोग र लुइस ल्यासेनलले आरोहण गरे — आरोहण गरिएको पहिलो ८,००० मिटर शिखर।

question: The capital of Lumbini Province is:
explanation: Deukhuri in the Rapti Valley (Dang district) is the capital of Lumbini Province; Butwal was the temporary capital.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लुम्बिनी प्रदेशको राजधानी कुन हो?
explanation_ne: राप्ती उपत्यकाको देउखुरी (दाङ जिल्ला) लुम्बिनी प्रदेशको राजधानी हो; बुटवल अस्थायी राजधानी थियो।

question: The capital of Sudurpashchim Province is:
explanation: Dhangadhi is the capital of Sudurpashchim Province.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेशको राजधानी कुन हो?
explanation_ne: धनगढी सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेशको राजधानी हो।

question: The longest river of Nepal is the:
explanation: The Karnali (507 km in Nepal) is Nepal's longest river; the Koshi is the largest by volume.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको सबैभन्दा लामो नदी कुन हो?
explanation_ne: कर्णाली (नेपालमा ५०७ किमि) नेपालको सबैभन्दा लामो नदी हो; कोशी आयतनमा सबैभन्दा ठूलो हो।

question: The Koshi river is also known as:
explanation: The Koshi is called Saptakoshi because seven rivers join to form it; it is also known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' for its floods.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कोशी नदीलाई अर्को के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: कोशीलाई सप्तकोशी भनिन्छ किनकि सात नदी मिलेर यो बन्छ; बाढीका कारण यसलाई 'बिहारको दुःख' पनि भनिन्छ।

question: The largest lake of Nepal is:
explanation: Rara Lake (10.8 km²) in Mugu is Nepal's largest lake; Tilicho is the highest lake in the world.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो ताल कुन हो?
explanation_ne: मुगुको रारा ताल (१०.८ वर्ग किमि) नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो ताल हो; तिलिचो विश्वको सबैभन्दा अग्लो ताल हो।

question: Tilicho Lake is famous as the:
options: Highest lake in the world (4,919 m)
explanation: Tilicho Lake (4,919 m) in Manang is one of the highest lakes in the world.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तिलिचो ताल के रूपमा प्रसिद्ध छ?
explanation_ne: मनाङको तिलिचो ताल (४,९१९ मि) विश्वको सबैभन्दा अग्लो तालमध्ये एक हो।

question: Nepal was unified by Prithvi Narayan Shah in which year (BS)?
explanation: Prithvi Narayan Shah unified Nepal and captured Kathmandu in 1825 BS (1768 AD); Nepal's unification is dated to 1768–69 AD.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पृथ्वीनारायण शाहले नेपाल एकीकरण कुन वर्ष (वि.सं.) मा गरे?
explanation_ne: पृथ्वीनारायण शाहले नेपाल एकीकरण गरे र १८२५ वि.सं. (सन् १७६८) मा काठमाडौं कब्जा गरे; नेपाल एकीकरण सन् १७६८–६९ मा भएको मानिन्छ।

question: The Sugauli Treaty was signed in which year?
explanation: The Sugauli Treaty was signed on 4 March 1816 between Nepal and the British East India Company after the Anglo-Nepal War (1814–16).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुगौली सन्धि कुन वर्षमा भयो?
explanation_ne: सुगौली सन्धि एङ्ग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध (१८१४–१६) पछि ४ मार्च १८१६ मा नेपाल र ब्रिटिस इस्ट इन्डिया कम्पनीबीच भयो।

question: The Anglo-Nepal War was fought during which years?
explanation: The Anglo-Nepal War (1814–16) ended with the Sugauli Treaty of 1816.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एङ्ग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध कुन वर्षमा भयो?
explanation_ne: एङ्ग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध (१८१४–१६) सन् १८१६ को सुगौली सन्धिबाट समाप्त भयो।

question: The Kot Parva (Kot Massacre) took place in which year?
explanation: The Kot Parva of 14 September 1846 brought Jung Bahadur Rana to power and began the Rana regime (1846–1951).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कोत पर्व कुन वर्षमा भयो?
explanation_ne: १४ सेप्टेम्बर १८४६ को कोत पर्वले जंगबहादुर राणालाई सत्तामा ल्यायो र राणा शासन (१८४६–१९५१) सुरु भयो।

question: The Rana regime in Nepal lasted from which years?
explanation: The Rana regime lasted from the Kot Parva of 1846 until the democratic revolution of 1951.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा राणा शासन कुन वर्षदेखि कुन वर्षसम्म चल्यो?
explanation_ne: राणा शासन १८४६ को कोत पर्वदेखि १९५१ को प्रजातान्त्रिक क्रान्तिसम्म चल्यो।

question: Democracy was first established in Nepal in which year?
explanation: Democracy was established in Nepal in 1951 AD (2007 BS) after the revolution against the Rana regime.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा पहिलो पटक प्रजातन्त्र कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: राणा शासनविरुद्धको क्रान्तिपछि नेपालमा सन् १९५१ (वि.सं. २००७) मा प्रजातन्त्र स्थापना भयो।

question: King Mahendra introduced the Panchayat system in Nepal in which year?
explanation: King Mahendra dissolved the elected government and introduced the partyless Panchayat system on 15 December 1960 (1 Poush 2017 BS).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: राजा महेन्द्रले नेपालमा पञ्चायत व्यवस्था कुन वर्षमा सुरु गरे?
explanation_ne: राजा महेन्द्रले निर्वाचित सरकार विघटन गरी १५ डिसेम्बर १९६० (१ पुस २०१७) मा निर्दलीय पञ्चायत व्यवस्था सुरु गरे।

question: The People's Movement (Jana Andolan) that restored multiparty democracy in Nepal took place in which year?
explanation: The Jana Andolan of 1990 (2046 BS) ended the Panchayat system and restored multiparty democracy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा बहुदलीय प्रजातन्त्र पुनर्स्थापना गर्ने जनआन्दोलन कुन वर्षमा भयो?
explanation_ne: सन् १९९० (वि.सं. २०४६) को जनआन्दोलनले पञ्चायत व्यवस्था अन्त्य गरी बहुदलीय प्रजातन्त्र पुनर्स्थापना गर्यो।

question: The monarchy in Nepal was abolished in which year?
explanation: The first Constituent Assembly abolished the monarchy on 28 May 2008 (15 Jestha 2065 BS), declaring Nepal a federal democratic republic.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा राजतन्त्र कुन वर्षमा अन्त्य भयो?
explanation_ne: पहिलो संविधान सभाले २८ मे २००८ (१५ जेठ २०६५) मा राजतन्त्र अन्त्य गरी नेपाललाई संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र घोषणा गर्यो।

question: The first Constituent Assembly election in Nepal was held in which year?
explanation: The first Constituent Assembly election was held on 10 April 2008 (2064 BS).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा पहिलो संविधान सभा निर्वाचन कुन वर्षमा भयो?
explanation_ne: पहिलो संविधान सभा निर्वाचन १० अप्रिल २००८ (वि.सं. २०६४) मा भयो।

question: The great earthquake that struck Nepal on 25 April 2015 had a magnitude of:
explanation: The Gorkha earthquake of 25 April 2015 had a magnitude of 7.8 and killed nearly 9,000 people.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: २५ अप्रिल २०१५ मा नेपालमा गएको ठूलो भूकम्पको परिमाण कति थियो?
explanation_ne: २५ अप्रिल २०१५ को गोरखा भूकम्पको परिमाण ७.८ थियो र यसले झण्डै ९,००० मानिसको ज्यान लियो।

question: The 2015 Gorkha earthquake struck Nepal on which date?
explanation: The Gorkha earthquake struck on 25 April 2015 (12 Baisakh 2072), with a major aftershock on 12 May 2015.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सन् २०१५ को गोरखा भूकम्प नेपालमा कुन मितिमा गयो?
explanation_ne: गोरखा भूकम्प २५ अप्रिल २०१५ (१२ वैशाख २०७२) मा गयो, १२ मे २०१५ मा ठूलो परकम्पसहित।

question: Lumbini, the birthplace of Gautam Buddha, is located in which district of Nepal?
explanation: Lumbini is in Rupandehi district, Lumbini Province; Kapilvastu (Tilaurakot) is where Buddha spent his early life.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गौतम बुद्धको जन्मस्थल लुम्बिनी नेपालको कुन जिल्लामा छ?
explanation_ne: लुम्बिनी लुम्बिनी प्रदेशको रुपन्देही जिल्लामा छ; कपिलवस्तु (तिलौराकोट) बुद्धले प्रारम्भिक जीवन बिताएको ठाउँ हो।

question: Chitwan National Park was established in which year?
explanation: Chitwan National Park, Nepal's first national park, was established in 1973 AD (2030 BS).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चितवन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: नेपालको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज चितवन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज सन् १९७३ (वि.सं. २०३०) मा स्थापना भयो।

question: Sagarmatha National Park was established in which year?
explanation: Sagarmatha National Park was established in 1976 AD (2033 BS) and listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1979.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सगरमाथा राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: सगरमाथा राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज सन् १९७६ (वि.सं. २०३३) मा स्थापना भयो र सन् १९७९ मा युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदा सूचीमा पर्यो।
